entities.name: RRC Connection Release Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE when upper layers request release of RRC connection as specified in TS 24.501. Not initiated for power saving purposes.

entities.name: Upper Layers
entities.description: Protocol layers above RRC that can request RRC connection release.

entities.name: PCell Barring Indication
entities.description: Condition where upper layers indicate barring of the PCell.

entities.name: PCell Barred Treatment
entities.description: UE treats the PCell used prior to entering RRC_IDLE as barred according to TS 38.304.

entities.name: Actions upon going to RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Actions performed when transitioning to RRC_IDLE state with release cause 'other' as specified in clause 5.3.11.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not connected to the network.

relations.description: Procedure is initiated when upper layers request RRC connection release.
Procedure execution is guarded by condition of PCell barring indication from upper layers.
PCell barring indication condition establishes that UE treats PCell as barred.
Procedure includes performing actions upon going to RRC_IDLE as a step.
Performing RRC_IDLE entry actions establishes transition to RRC_IDLE state.
